description: Unspecified vulnerability in JustSystems Corporation ATOK 2006 through 2009 and ATOK flat-rate service, and Just Smile 4 with the ATOK Smile module, allows physically proximate users to bypass the screen lock and execute commands with system privileges via unknown vectors related to "launching external applications."

summary: Buffer overflow in the "create torrent dialog" functionality in uTorrent 1.8.3 build 15772, and possibly other versions before 1.8.3 (Build 16010), allows user-assisted remote attackers to cause a denial of service (a…
description: Buffer overflow in the "create torrent dialog" functionality in uTorrent 1.8.3 build 15772, and possibly other versions before 1.8.3 (Build 16010), allows user-assisted remote attackers to cause a denial of service (application crash) and possibly execute arbitrary code via a text file containing a large string.  NOTE: some of these details are obtained from third party information.

summary: SQL injection vulnerability in default.php in Cornerstone Technologies webConductor allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary SQL commands via the id parameter.
description: SQL injection vulnerability in default.php in Cornerstone Technologies webConductor allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary SQL commands via the id parameter.
